userStories.name: Correct realtime subscription status documentation
userStories.description: Update the OSv2 status document so realtime subscription capability reflects the live SSE ObjectSet subscribe endpoint, WebSocket subscription endpoint, funnel broadcast hub, and Browser/ObjectSet live UI instead of claiming the surface is absent.
bdd_acceptance: Given cmd/server mounts `/api/v2/ontologies/{ontologyApiName}/subscriptions/ws` and `/api/v2/ontologies/{ontologyApiName}/objectSets/{objectSetRid}/subscribe`, When an operator reads docs/PRD-Weave-OSv2-深度复刻-V2.md, Then the realtime rows no longer say there is no client subscription endpoint, WebSocket, or SSE endpoint.

Given pkg/funnel/broadcast.go and pkg/oss/subscribe_sse.go provide the live SSE event path, When the status document describes realtime architecture, Then it names the funnel broadcast hub, ObjectSet SSE subscribe handler, Last-Event-ID/since replay behavior, and per-user connection guard.

Given web/src/hooks/useObjectSetSubscription.ts, BrowserPage realtime mode, and ObjectSetLivePage expose live subscription UI, When the frontend status row is read, Then it describes the shipped Browser/ObjectSet live surfaces rather than saying subscribe UI is missing.

userStories.name: Correct CLI capability status documentation
userStories.description: Update the OSv2 status document so CLI coverage reflects the shipped action, aggregate, and ObjectSet command files and tests instead of treating those commands as missing.
bdd_acceptance: Given cmd/weave-cli includes cmd_action.go, cmd_aggregate.go, and cmd_objectset.go, When a developer reads the CLI rows and gap list, Then action, aggregate, and objectset commands are described as shipped surfaces with remaining depth gaps rather than absent features.
Given cmd/weave-cli has command tests for the current CLI contract, When the docs contract runs, Then stale claims such as CLI action/aggregate/objectset not exposed fail until corrected.
Given operators need concrete command discovery, When the CLI section is read, Then it references the available command names and points to docs/cli.md or the command files for details.

userStories.name: Correct MCP status matrix stub claims
userStories.description: Update the OSv2 status document so MCP status rows and gap notes align with the live prompts/resources contract and stdio HTTP bridge already documented in docs/mcp.md.
bdd_acceptance: Given docs/mcp.md and pkg/mcp describe live prompts/list, prompts/get, resources/list, and resources/read, When the OSv2 status document is checked, Then it no longer says prompts/resources are stubs.

Given cmd/weave-mcp bridges stdio clients to a running `/mcp` endpoint when WEAVE_MCP_URL is set, When the MCP stdio row is read, Then it describes bridge mode and remaining local-standalone gaps instead of calling the binary a stub.
Given the MCP docs contract already protects docs/mcp.md, When the status-doc contract runs, Then stale MCP stub wording in docs/PRD-Weave-OSv2-深度复刻-V2.md fails until corrected.
